book.title: The Principles of Product Development Flow
book.author: Donald G. Reinertsen

predict.question: B starts empty, receives seven and serves six each round for six rounds. How many waiting jobs remain in B?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: The Principles of Product Development Flow emphasizes queues and the economic consequences of managing development flow.
modelBoundary: A leaves {A} waiting jobs; B leaves {B}. The same six-job service can absorb five arrivals but accumulates one per round when seven arrive. Fixed arrivals and service only; no stochastic near-capacity queueing law or utilization nonlinearity is shown.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real-world applicability and the connection to the book remain unverified.
